name: D.I.G.
desc:
DIG IS IN BETA; Expect bugs and balancing issues. Thank you for your support. Join the community server to report bugs.

Hover Mouse over UI in bottom left corner to see tool controls.
B - Quick Chat

DIG is a sandbox shooter inspired by classic Roblox games!! Each match takes place throughout a valley whereby the goal is to capture the other team's base by fully lowering their flag.

Use your shovel tool to dig trenches and fortify your base/FOB.
Get utility and weapons from the radio to assist in your battle.
Take victory swiftly, stockpiles only have enough food for 3 days of fighting.

Inspired by Foxhole, Trenches (Pordier at War), Underground War, Something Evil Will Happen, The W, and Dream Dive.
